engine/Debug/renderer ABIs, authoritative totals, terminal reason, even Debug sequence, frame token, and boot stage valid
all renderer/DMA/VBlank/Z80/audio/engine/vocabulary cumulative fault fields are zero at 54 checkpoints
all seven fixed pool counts/high-water values match complete slot scans inside Genesis work RAM; vocabulary update units are 0 at initial and 2904 thereafter, within 4096
observed SAT/scanline/pixel/DMA word/depth values are within 64/20/320/2048/32 published conservative limits
playing audio shadow is healthy with zero late/timeout faults; Z80 V-int excess remains within the published startup allowance
switch, echo-projectile/node, two-echo closed/open leaf, dash, terminal-hold start/late, and PROGRAM_STABLE terminal snapshots are present in both sessions
ROM, symbols, canonical runtime prerequisite, emulator/config, B03 collector, budget collector/schema/probe, isolated copies, and transcript are SHA-256 bound and unchanged

limitations: The pass covers only two fresh NTSC Debug-ROM B03 fixture sessions executing the exact canonical 720+720+292 authoritative-step route.

PRE and POST breakpoints occur around every gameplay step. The measurements therefore prove public cumulative fault counters, bounded pools, conservative DMA/SAT limits, and deterministic signatures; they do not profile CPU cycles or spare VBlank time.
Checkpoint reads occur at the post-gameplay main-loop boundary. Renderer telemetry describes the most recently completed renderer build, which can be the preceding authoritative step.
No visual-quality, PAL double-step, save, physical-hardware, full campaign, or Release-ROM performance claim is made.
No unmeasured Release-ROM equivalence is inferred from this Debug fixture evidence.
